title: fix(cli): preserve whitespace in piped embedding inputs
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: Piped input to the Polli CLI’s embeddings command now preserves whitespace instead of trimming it. Text and audio commands keep their default stdin trimming behavior. The existing stdin regression test now covers whitespace, and the CLI version and lockfile were bumped.
